mapper.select: SELECT m.ast10_manager_id AS manager_id , m.ast10_company_id AS company_id , m.ast10_link_id AS link_id , m.ast10_manager_type AS manager_type , f_cdnm('ShareCode', m.ast10_manager_type, m.ast10_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS manager_name , m.ast10_org_id AS org_id , f_org_nm(m.ast10_org_id, f_sysdate()) AS org_name , m.ast10_person_id AS person_id , f_emp_kor_nm(m.ast10_person_id) AS person_name , m.ast10_repr_yn AS repr_yn , m.ast10_link_content AS link_content FROM ast10_manager m WHERE m.ast10_link_id = #{linkId} AND m.ast10_company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY m.ast10_manager_type, m.ast10_org_id

SELECT m.ast10_manager_id AS manager_id , m.ast10_company_id AS company_id , m.ast10_link_id AS link_id , m.ast10_manager_type AS manager_type , f_cdnm('ShareCode', m.ast10_manager_type, m.ast10_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS manager_name , m.ast10_org_id AS org_id , f_org_nm(m.ast10_org_id, f_sysdate()) AS org_name , m.ast10_person_id AS person_id , f_emp_kor_nm(m.ast10_person_id) AS person_name , m.ast10_repr_yn AS repr_yn , m.ast10_link_content AS link_content FROM ast10_manager m WHERE m.ast10_manager_id = #{managerId}
